From 9779a8e61a83916ccfe7e6ddabcc7638d4bc2ae1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Mar 2022 14:23:18 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: Intel: boards: fix randconfig issue

on x86_64:

ERROR: modpost: "sof_dai_get_bclk"
[sound/soc/intel/boards/snd-soc-intel-sof-cirrus-common.ko] undefined!

ERROR: modpost: "sof_dai_get_mclk"
[sound/soc/intel/boards/snd-soc-intel-sof-realtek-common.ko]
undefined!

This comes from a missing dependency on at least ONE SOF platform
being selected. This dependency exists for all other machine drivers,
this was missed in the earlier reviews.

Fixes: 2fe14ff61bd6 ("ASoC: Intel: sof_ssp_amp: rename driver and support cs35l41 amplifier")
Reported-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Signed-off-by: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Acked-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Tested-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Reviewed-by: Cezary Rojewski <cezary.rojewski@intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220308202318.401358-1-pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig b/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
index 6884ddf9edad..81e012c164b0 100644
--- a/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
+++ b/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
@@ -615,6 +615,8 @@ config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_DA7219_MAX98373_MACH
 
 endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_JASPERLAKE
 
+if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
+
 config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
 	tristate "SOF with amplifiers in I2S Mode"
 	depends on I2C && ACPI
@@ -631,6 +633,7 @@ config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
 	   with RT1308/CS35L41 I2S audio codec.
 	   Say Y if you have such a device.
 	   If unsure select "N".
+endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
 
 if SND_SOC_SOF_ELKHARTLAKE
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig`**
   - Added a conditional block that checks if `SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK` is enabled.
   - Wrapped the configuration for `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` within this conditional block, ensuring that it is only available if `SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK` is selected.
   - This change helps to establish a dependency that was previously missing, which is necessary for the proper functioning of the machine driver.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `Kconfig` file address a bug related to undefined symbols (`sof_dai_get_bclk` and `sof_dai_get_mclk`) during the module post-processing stage. By adding the dependency on `SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK`, the patch ensures that the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration is only available when the necessary SOF platform is selected. This relationship is crucial for preventing the errors reported by Randy Dunlap, as it aligns the configuration with the requirements of the machine drivers, thereby fixing the randconfig issue on x86_64 systems.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a missing dependency in the Kconfig file that resulted in the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration being available without the necessary SOF platform being selected. This led to undefined symbols (`sof_dai_get_bclk` and `sof_dai_get_mclk`) during module post-processing, as the required functions were not linked properly due to the absence of the appropriate configuration.

Here is the patch:
 endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_JASPERLAKE
 
+if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
+
 config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
 	tristate "SOF with amplifiers in I2S Mode"
 	   Say Y if you have such a device.
 	   If unsure select "N".
+endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
 
 if SND_SOC_SOF_ELKHARTLAKE

This missing dependency meant that the required functions were not linked properly.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
```
Reason:
By wrapping the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration within the `if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK` conditional, the configuration is now only available when the necessary SOF platform is selected, ensuring that the required functions are properly linked and preventing the undefined symbol errors.
